_comment: Shape reference AND smoke test for the renderer. Copy this to output/<segment>/concepts.json and replace the contents with real step-3/4 output. Every line here is claim-safe felt-experience language; the one quote is verbatim from the desk-workers evidence file so qa.py's quote check passes.

concepts.angle: failed-solution: the pillow flattens, so they rebuild it nightly

slots.eyebrow: If you sit at a desk all day
slots.headline: One height. All night.
slots.subhead: Latex springs back instead of sinking through, so you are not rebuilding it in the dark.

concepts.angle: failed-solution: stacking and folding is a workaround, not an answer

slots.hook:
Stacking two pillows is not a fix.
It is a workaround.
slots.left_copy: Fold one, stack another, wedge a towel under it. Rebuild it every night.
slots.right_copy: One piece of latex, set to one height, that is still that height in the morning.

concepts.angle: pain-led: the day's tightness follows them to bed

slots.hook: You already know why your shoulders feel like that.
slots.quote: Chances are, you are tight in your upper back from sitting at a desk all day.

concepts.angle: objection-busting: burned before by foam that softened

slots.objection: “It will feel great for a month, then go flat like the last one.”
slots.answer_label: Fair. So here is the deal
slots.reframe: Sleep on it for a season, not a fortnight.
slots.subhead: Foam softens as it ages. Latex does not. And you get a full season to find out.

concepts.angle: desired-outcome: waking without the morning reset ritual

slots.hook:
The difference is not your morning.
It is your 3am.
slots.before_copy: Awake. Flipping it over. Folding it in half. Trying the other side.
slots.after_copy: Slept through. No stretching it out before you can face the screen.

concepts.angle: mechanism: why it still has its shape in month six

slots.hook: Why it is still the same pillow in month six.
slots.step_1_desc: It softens as it ages. The height you bought is not the height you keep.
slots.step_2_desc: It pushes back to the same shape every time you move.
slots.step_3_desc: Nothing to stack, fold or replace at the six-month mark.
